payload.title: Async side-effect projection seam for Rust app backends
payload.description: Crate CR-112 outbound-sync migration exposed a reusable Frick gap: Rust FrickProjectionHandler::apply is synchronous and FrickProjectionContext carries tenant/app only, but app-owned projections sometimes need post-commit async side effects such as store reads, job enqueue, notification intent enqueue, or durable audit writes. Crate can temporarily bridge crate.outbound-sync-enqueue by spawning async work from apply, but a first-class Frick seam should make this deterministic and observable without failing the originating write. Candidate designs: async projection handler trait, post-commit side-effect projection registry, or app write-listener fanout integrated with the existing store write funnel. Acceptance should cover async store read + enqueue_job from an InventoryEventStream-like append, detached error logging/telemetry, no regression to projection snapshot/delta behavior, and compatibility with multi-app app_id routing.
